subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept announce completion handoffs as always tool-free and reconcile interrupted announce delivery turns to non-running session state after the reserved-prefix fix?
rationale: The patch changes both persisted restart recovery semantics and an internal tool boundary; automation can repair the prefix bug, but maintainer intent should decide the canonical recovery state and boundary.

options.title: Accept after prefix repair
options.body: Reserve or otherwise protect announce run identity, resolve conflicts and lint, then land this as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

options.title: Change the recovery state
options.body: If killed is not the intended stored state for aborted delivery-only turns, request that terminal-state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader model
options.body: If maintainers want a unified model for all inter-session delivery recovery, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept after prefix repair
recommendation.body: Reserve or otherwise protect announce run identity, resolve conflicts and lint, then land this as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn commits make this the closest available owner for the session-state and tool-boundary choice.
